core_obligations: Derive part (1) from the permanence lemma with Z = S = Spec(Z) (proof lines 1488-1490).
Derive part (2) from part (1) and the composition statement for separatedness (proof lines 1491-1492).
For part (3), show that X x_Y Z -> Z is quasi-compact and quasi-separated as a base change using (2) and base change stability (proof lines 1493-1498).
Conclude that the fibre product is quasi-compact and quasi-separated over Z, hence as an algebraic space (proof lines 1499-1503).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma with three assertions: a morphism from a quasi-compact space to a quasi-separated one is quasi-compact; if moreover the source is quasi-separated then the morphism is quasi-compact and quasi-separated; and a fibre product of quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic spaces is again quasi-compact and quasi-separated (source lines 1473-1485). Part (1) specialises the permanence lemma for triangles over Spec(Z); part (2) combines (1) with the composition statement for separatedness; part (3) shows that the projection of the fibre product is quasi-compact and quasi-separated as a base change, and then deduces the two properties for the fibre product itself from the corresponding over-the-base statements.
